notes.title: Editing mode Fix
notes.content:
* In editing mode, cubes will not be bumped with dragging door.

* In editing mode, a few steps are added before uploading a level for confirmation .

notes.title: Level editor update undergoing
notes.content:
Noticing player having difficulty in using the level editor, I hope to launch an update within two weeks to improve the usage.
Sorry for the bad experience. Every player who has used the Level editor is treated as one of our developers.
